ValidationRule.description: To validate Additional Correspondence reviewed checkbox to be true only when Case Status is Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), NOT( OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Withdrawn"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Resolved"))), IDR_Additional_Correspondence_reviewed__c = True )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Field only editable on closed complaints
